0x000800.en: 「As I am now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008F9.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x0009EA.en: 「Time to fall back...! I'm pulling out.」

0x000A22.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000B23.en: 「Guh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B5E.en: 「No way I go down here...!@　This isn't funny...」

0x000BB2.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000C26.en: 「Guh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D03.en: 「This is it... The rest is up to you.」

0x000DAF.en: 「No good, too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000DFC.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000E3A.en: 「Kyaa! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E81.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F2C.en: 「Guh... So I'm the falling star... I'm ejecting!」

0x0010D5.en: 「Guh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00111C.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x001151.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as my power goes...!」

0x00123D.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm not ready yet...!」

0x00128B.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Falling back!」

0x0012CF.en: 「Is... is this the end for me...!?」

0x001346.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x001375.en: 「No good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013B3.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x0013E2.en: 「I can't go on any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x00146D.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0015A1.en: 「So this... is the end for me...!」

0x001800.en: 「So I still have a way to go...!」

0x0018A3.en: 「Blast, I've gone and gotten myself hit.」

0x0018D5.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to retreat...!」

0x00196C.en: 「Hey, Masaki. Could you tell me a little more@ about Prince Feil?」

0x0019DA.en: 「Yeah, yeah, I want to hear too.」

0x001A40.en: 「Sheesh, he just showed his face once and@ he's this popular.」

0x001A99.en: 「There are tons of people back in Langran@ who look up to Prince Feil too.」

0x001B17.en: 「Well, I figure you'll get it once you meet him...@ He's earnest, and for someone who's first in line to the@ throne, he's got no airs about him.」

0x001BB6.en: 「Yeah, he talks to me like a regular person too.@ We even had dinner together at my place once.」

0x001C36.en: 「A down-to-earth prince... he sounds more wonderful by the minute.」

0x001C6D.en: (Aya's more of a fangirl than I'd have thought.)

0x001C9E.en: 「His Highness is a truly good man. He honestly@ frets over where this world is headed.」

0x001D0F.en: 「Yeah...@ Langran should be united, but thanks to@ General Kirkus's rise, it's splitting apart.」

0x001DB4.en: 「The great nation of Langran kept the world@ in balance, but this war has let@ Shutedonias grow strong.」

0x001E53.en: 「President Zorousharld of the Shutedonias@ Union is a hardcore hawk... and behind him@ is the arms conglomerate Trinity.」

0x001EFE.en: 「At this rate, it's obvious all of <La Gias>@ will be dragged into the war.」

0x001F74.en: 「Before that happens, we need to reunite@ Langran under Prince Feil, fast, and blunt@ Shutedonias's power.」

0x002022.en: 「It's ordinary folks who suffer in a war...@ We've gotta do something, and soon.」

0x0020BC.en: 「It's just, it's not like Masa to talk@ so seriously...」

0x002162.en: (Big brother...@ what did you talk about, up on the surface?)

0x0021E7.en: 「...We're under a surprise attack right now.@ I'm sorry to ask, but I'd like the Hagane to@ hit the enemy's main camp south of Banan City.」

0x0022AA.en: 「Are you sure you don't need us to come to your aid?」

0x0022E7.en: 「We'll manage somehow here.@ Besides, if their main camp comes under attack,@ the raiding force should lose its nerve.」

0x00237A.en: 「Understood.@ Then we'll head for southern Banan City.」

0x0023D0.en: 「An enemy raid. Honestly, what a pain.@ The jamming we set up for the ambush's come back to bite us.」

0x002444.en: 「And that battleship... that's the surface-dwellers' ship.@ This is gonna be a nasty one.」

0x0024B0.en: 「General Jesuha, there's a <Masou Kishin> among the enemy!」

0x002545.en: 「Yikes... tough opponents.@ No help for it, let's bring that out.」

0x0025D2.en: 「It's fine, I'll take responsibility.@ Get it ready in Type-1 gear, on the double.」

0x002656.en: 「I'll ride it myself. It'll work out somehow.」

0x002699.en: 「So that's the enemy's main force? Fewer than I expected.」

0x0026DC.en: 「Best to assume there are still enemy units@ inside the mobile fortress.」

0x002738.en: 「Whatever comes out, we'll smash it all!@ Let's go, everyone!」

0x0027C8.en: 「If that's all, we can handle it.@ Let's finish this in one go!」

0x00285B.en: 「Please wait, General!@ The guardian spirit's control coefficient hasn't reached 75!」

0x0028CC.en: 「Over 70's plenty.@ The only way to counter a Masou Kishin@ is with a Masou Kishin. All right, I'm heading out!」

0x002996.en: 「Impossible!@ They'd gotten their hands on that thing!?」

0x002B3C.en: 「Yes.@ But who in the world got hold of Zamzeed...?」

0x002B86.en: 「...All right, I can't draw out its full power,@ but I can fight somehow. I'll finish this quick,@ so brace yourselves.」

0x002C4A.en: 「...The pilot is most likely someone from Shutedonias.」

0x002C96.en: 「And it seems they're using a geas.@ Zamzeed's guardian spirit is earth...@ A flame compulsion spell could control it.」

0x002D4A.en: 「But since Zamzeed is being controlled against@ its own will, it must be suffering@ terrible agony...」

0x002DF8.en: 「Yeah, a Masou Kishin chooses its own pilot.@ To force it into submission like that...!」

0x002EBC.en: 「M-Mio, you... you can feel Zamzeed's heart!?」

0x002F30.en: 「This... looks like there's no mistaking it.@ Riding Diablo, reading Zamzeed's heart...」

0x00303D.en: 「No! You can't! She's not up to it!」

0x003080.en: 「Tytti, I know how you feel, but...」

0x0030B7.en: 「Masaki, I'm not clinging to what happened in the past.@ It's just, with Mio's skill...」

0x00312E.en: 「...For now, if that's one of the Masou Kishin,@ isn't it better to take it back?」

0x0031A8.en: 「Yeah, that's right.@ Tytti, talk later. First, Zamzeed!」

0x003257.en: 「Sorry to do this to Zamzeed, but we'll pin it down by force.@ It's pretty sturdy. Just don't overdo it@ and shoot it down.」

0x003318.en: 「Yikes, my recklessness caught up with me. It won't move.@ At this rate they'll catch me...@ Nothing for it but to run and risk a demotion.」

0x0033D3.en: 「Masaki, someone's coming out of the cockpit!」

0x00342F.en: 「Boy, I'm not that slow.@ If fate allows, we'll meet again. Now then, retreat!」

0x0034D8.en: 「...Tch, quick on his feet, that one.」

0x003509.en: 「But the enemy's main force pulled back,@ and we got Zamzeed back too.」

0x00355F.en: 「Yeah... Prince Feil should be all right too.@ Everyone, sorry, but help me recover Zamzeed.」

0x0035F4.en: 「As if the likes of you could ever handle Zamzeed!?」

0x00363A.en: 「Ho ho, a lively kid, aren't you.」

0x003674.en: 「What's with this guy? That's a heavy Troia accent.」

0x0036B4.en: 「You, get out of Zamzeed and surrender!」

0x0036FA.en: 「Don't be daft! Like I could do that!」

0x003734.en: 「Then I don't like it, but@ I'll have to do this by force...!」

0x003790.en: 「Bring it on, come and get me!」

0x0037F2.en: 「Zamzeed's in pain, it's crying!@ Get out of it, now!」

0x00385A.en: 「Ho... you look like a surface-dweller, missy.@ Stick your nose in a place like this and@ you'll get a lot worse than hurt.」

0x0038F9.en: 「I knew that going in!@ We're taking Zamzeed back!」

0x0039B1.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Saitzev State, Banan City

0x003A0A.en: 「Zamzeed...@ Guess there was no getting it back unscathed.」

0x003A6C.en: 「It's all broken up... can it be fixed?」

0x003AA3.en: 「If we take it to Prince Feil, it should be fine.」

0x003AE6.en: 「...Hey, Masaki.@ What's it feel like, piloting a Masou Kishin?」

0x003B42.en: 「When I first saw Zamzeed, I thought it was crying.@　Like a brother or a dear friend was in terrible pain...@　And I felt I had to save it...」

0x003C40.en: 「Each Machinery God is bound by a pact with a@　high-ranking spirit, giving it that spirit's power.」

0x003CB4.en: 「You could say they're like people themselves.@　That's why a Machinery God chooses its pilot,@　someone its spirit can attune to.」

0x003D47.en: 「So, Mio... because you understood Zamzeed's heart,@　it chose you.」

0x003DE3.en: 「Being a Machinery God pilot brings rights and duties.@　Prince Feil will explain it in time, but...」

0x003E6C.en: 「First, a Machinery God pilot need not@　bow to any authority.@　Their will takes precedence over any state decree.」

0x003F0C.en: 「And their duty is this: when the world faces ruin...@　when a threat appears that could bring@　catastrophe upon La Gias...」

0x00402E.en: 「That's what I thought when I first heard it too.@　But fulfilling a Machinery God pilot's duty@　is no easy thing.」

0x0040F5.en: 「Yeah. Build enough strength to see it through,@ plus strength of heart. A pilot gone wicked@ will be rejected by their guardian spirit.」

0x0041EF.en: 「Whoa, you're being honest for once. Wish you always were.」

0x00423E.en: 「...Let me ask one last thing.@　If a Machinery God pilot doesn't have to@　obey any authority...」

0x0042CB.en: 「Then why do you and Tytti@　fight under Prince Feil?」

0x00432D.en: 「That's... because the Prince acts out of@　concern for where this world is headed.」

0x004395.en: 「Yeah... we judged it for ourselves and@　chose to lend him our strength. Besides,@　there's plenty in this world worth protecting too.」

0x0044AE.en: 「...Just for a bit. Don't worry about me...」

0x004513.en: 「...Was there something between Tytti and Zamzeed?」

0x00455F.en: 「Yeah.@　More precisely, with Zamzeed's former pilot...」

0x0045AC.en: （Ricardo... the Zamzeed you fought beside@　has chosen a new pilot...）

0x004620.en: （I always knew this day would come...@　Yes, because even with you gone, Zamzeed@　goes on existing...）

0x0046F6.en: 「Irm... gult. What do you need from me?」

0x004789.en: 「No, when I flirt, I pick women who smile.@　Preying on a woman in tears isn't my style.」

0x004862.en: 「Could it be the one who made you cry was...@　someone tied to your memories of Zamzeed's pilot?」

0x0048D9.en: 「That's... in the past now.@　Enough that I can keep the tears from others, at least.」

0x004947.en: 「But Zamzeed came back.@　To you and Masaki and the rest.」

0x0049A0.en: 「You don't have to dwell on it anymore...@　Isn't that what Zamzeed's telling you?@　That's the feeling I get.」

0x004A37.en: 「Well, I'm not one the Machinery Gods chose,@　so what do I really know...」

0x004B0D.en: 「Ah, there's that smile again.@　Much better. That face suits you far more.@　See you around.」

0x004B8B.en: （...Zamzeed's heart... yes...@　Langran needs the Machinery Gods now...）

0x004C05.en: （If Zamzeed chose Mio...@　then I'll accept it too, Ricardo...）

0x004C79.en: 「...Not only did you repel their main force,@　you reclaimed Zamzeed as well... well done, Masaki.@　My thanks to everyone who helped, too.」

0x004D48.en: 「So, Prince... how are things on your end?」

0x004D7F.en: 「The enemy fell back in a panic.@　All that's left is retaking the capital.@　Let's regroup at Mount Gajetta.」

0x004DFD.en: 「Mount Gajetta, huh...@　Not a place I've got fond memories of, but...」

0x004E62.en: 「Then this ship will head your way now.」
